'Know your headroom.' collapses to a dot

Centred lockup + tagline
Overview: close on reset card, pan to Claude, pull back; headline
8 providers, one per beat
Crash zoom: bar fills to 71%, pace tick, goes wavy, chip
Wavy vs flat
Tap → detail; ring draws, digits roll
Pace chart + projection, camera follows
'Hit the limit anyway?' Codex at 100%, dims to night
Night: 15h 28m until Codex resets. 'Can't wait?'
Resets → sheet: 'Use a reset' → tap → Resetting…; riser push-in
HIT: 'Usage reset', bars refill, confetti, '2 resets left'
Or just wait: reset island grows from the cutout
Home screen widgets in a phone
Lock screen widget
Palette dolly, focus pull per beat
